options.axis_conversion: right-handed glTF to left-handed engine by X reflection
options.bind_shape: coherent joint-bind times inverse-bind; skinned mesh-node transform is ignored
options.interpolation: LINEAR TRS baked uniformly including endpoints; per-channel clamping

options.external_resources: exact explicit URI map only; no filesystem or network fallback
options.weight_policy: at most four influences; bounded float/UNORM quantization normalization only

import_memory.scope: private parser and conservative engine-owned accounting; not WIC, driver or whole-process memory
